spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.meaning: A weary guardian leans on his wand, bandaged yet standing, almost through the final test of endurance.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.meaning: Three women raise their cups in joyful dance, celebrating friendship, community and shared creativity.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.meaning: A crowned hand raises a double-edged sword through cloud, the sharp clarity of a decisive breakthrough.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Nine of Wands (权杖九) upright, highlighting courage, persistence, test of faith. Present (现在) draws Three of Cups (圣杯三) upright, highlighting celebration, friendship, creativity. Future (未来) draws Ace of Swords (宝剑王牌) upright, highlighting raw power, victory, breakthroughs. No Major Arcana appeared, so the reading turns on everyday, practical forces you can act on directly rather than on larger destiny-level themes. Every card fell upright, suggesting these energies express themselves clearly and without obstruction.
